name: Stained Glass Sky
source:
A cute but heart-wrenching science-fiction visual novel about two researchers on a far off planet, who finally see the UFO they've been looking for in the night sky above.

[From [url=https://minkonn.itch.io/stained-glass-sky]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部可爱但令人心碎的科幻视觉小说，讲述了两个遥远星球上的研究人员终于在夜空中看到了他们一直在寻找的不明飞行物的故事。

[来自[url=https://minkonn.itch.io/stained-glass-sky]itch.io[/url]]
